subject: general
question: Who is the author of the book 'Lessons Life Taught Me, Unknowingly'?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Anupam Kher.**____** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Anupam Kher **(born 7 March 1955)** is an Indian actor and the former** Chairman of the Film and Television Institute of India**.
 
• **Kirran Kher** is the wife of Anupam Kher,
 
• **Aagaman(1982**)is the first movie of anupam kher.
 
• Anupam Kher won the **Filmfare Award for Best Actor** for his performance in** Saaransh (1984**).
 
• Anupam Kher holds the record for winning the Filmfare Award for Best Comedian five times in total for,** Ram Lakhan (1989), Lamhe (1991), Khel (1992), Darr (1993) and Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge (1995).**
 
• Anupam Kher won the** National Film Award** for Special Mention twice for his performances in **Daddy (1989) and Maine Gandhi Ko Nahin Mara (2005).**
 
• important books by Anupam Kher,** your best day is today(2021), AAP khud hi best hai(2011), and Lesson Life thought me(2019)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Shilpa Shetty**-Shilpa Shetty Kundra is an Indian actress, film producer, dancer, author, businesswoman and former model who predominantly appeared in Hindi-language films.

 
 
• ​The important book of Shilpa Shetty-**The great Indian diet, Diary Of A Domestic Diva** 
 
 
 
• **Twinkle Khanna**-Twinkle Khanna is an Indian Interior designer, author, producer, and former film actress.
 
 
• ​The important books of Twinkle Khanna,** Mrs Funnybones, Pyjamas Are Forgiving, and The Legend of Lakshmi Prasad**.
 
 
 
• **​Javed Akhtar**-Javed Akhtar is an Indian poet, lyricist, screenwriter and political activist.
 
 
• ​The important book of Javed Akhtar, **Tarkash, Cinema Ke Baare Mein, Lava**, etc.
